method: Cut the baby potatoes into even 1–2cm pieces. Boil for 8–10 minutes until just tender, then drain and let the steam escape for a minute.
Chop the onion and spring onion. Heat the measured olive oil in a wide non-stick frying pan; cook the onion and spring onion over medium heat for 4–5 minutes.
Add the potatoes in a single layer. Cook for 6–8 minutes, turning a few times, until the edges are golden.
Add the cooked turkey breast in bite-size pieces and heat for 3–5 minutes, turning until steaming hot right through. It is already cooked; do not treat it as raw meat.
Serve the turkey breast, potatoes and vegetables immediately. Do not cool and reheat this assembled hash again.
